Hi Amit —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from my side and proposed next steps so we can get the technical deep dive on the calendar: 

1) Recap (from discovery)
- Stratus is prioritizing a marketplace-integrated offering for enterprise telco customers with strict data residency needs.
- Key success criteria: predictable latency under 100ms p99 for inference, ability to pin model versions, and auditability for data access.
- Primary internal stakeholders: Rina Shah (Marketplace Ops), and their platform team.

2) Proposed next step
- Partner-led technical deep dive (90 minutes): architecture walkthrough, deployment options (hosted vs. dedicated vs. private), and integration checklist for marketplace ingestion.
- Owners: Camila (Redwood partner engineering) to lead the demo; Laura to handle commercial Q&A.

3) Calendar options — please confirm which window works best for your team next week:
- Tue Nov 30, 10:00–11:30 PT / 13:00–14:30 ET
- Wed Dec 1, 13:00–14:30 PT / 16:00–17:30 ET

4) Ask for the meeting
- Please confirm the preferred time and the list of attendees (especially OPS/Marketplace + platform engineers). If you want Rina copied in here, add her and we’ll include a brief agenda.

Attached: redwood_one_pager.pdf and stratus_ma_draft_agenda.pdf (draft agenda to iterate before the deep dive).

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
